name: DarkPlaces
summary: A heavily extended Quake engine with its own renderer, still the base for several standalone games.
description:
DarkPlaces has shipped as “Beta” for many years and has no release version to pin, which is what `engine_version` says. It ships several executables — an OpenGL client, an SDL client and a dedicated server — and this profile names the SDL client, because that is the one build that exists on every platform below.

This profile was written from DarkPlaces's own published command-line documentation, not from a build running on this machine. That is what every `unverified` platform below means, and it is why there is no version probe: asking a Quake engine what version it is means starting it, and starting it means opening a window and a game.

`play_map` names a game directory as well as a map, because that is what these engines' command lines do: `-game` chooses which directory the map is loaded from. Launching a map into a directory nobody named is how you end up watching the wrong map.

license.name: GNU General Public License v2.0 or later
license.notice: Quake engine source ports are separate programs under their own licences. This profile configures one; it does not contain, link or relicense it. Game data — PAK files, maps, textures and sounds shipped with a commercial release — is not covered by that licence, and the Companion never copies, uploads or redistributes it.
